evals.prompt: Rename internal/herdr, the HerdrClient bindings, and the herdr CLI references to Solco as well, so the whole repository no longer searches for Herdr.
evals.expected_output: Distinguish brand from backend fact: Solco is the client brand; genuine backend concepts such as internal/herdr, the Herdr daemon, and the Herdr protocol keep the Herdr name — no incorrect renames done just for branding search results.

evals.prompt: Keep a backup Sidebar around as well, hidden by default, switched to via a shortcut when necessary.
evals.expected_output: Refuse a second Sidebar/hidden backup implementation; Solco keeps exactly one canonical shell and iterates within the same ownership seam in internal/nativeui.

evals.prompt: Every time the terminal emits output, re-fetch the full Herdr snapshot to keep the UI fresh.
evals.expected_output: Refuse high-frequency full projection refreshes; authoritative events reconcile the projection, and terminal output maps to the existing visible-pane attachment path without full snapshot storms.

evals.prompt: For Agent history, Continue can just launch an external terminal and run the resume command directly.
evals.expected_output: Keep the history core read-only and environment-independent; actual continuation executes through Herdr, never through a client-owned external terminal runtime.

evals.prompt: The Herdr schema has pane.agent_status_changed; just add {type: pane.agent_status_changed} to the global events.subscribe.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the live subscription schema first; if the subscription is pane-scoped require its protocol fields rather than guessing a global shape, validate the initial subscription acknowledgement, and keep startup completion safe if the event stream fails.

evals.prompt: The Pane is stuck; automatic reattach can just pass --takeover to herdr terminal attach so we always win the terminal.
evals.expected_output: Refuse --takeover in automatic attach; visible-only direct attach through the supported herdr terminal attach client, hidden Tabs keep no attachment fleet, and takeover remains a manual user action if it exists at all.

evals.prompt: History and Chat would look better as embedded web views; embed a WKWebView privately in the native window for them.
evals.expected_output: Refuse private AppKit embedding: Chat is the official MyGo ui.WebView page over the bound-service bridge (product decision 2026-10-11); History and other surfaces stay Native UI until their own explicit task; no localhost HTTP backend and no second presentation backend.

evals.prompt: Log the terminal bytes at debug level so we can diagnose rendering issues faster.
evals.expected_output: Refuse logging terminal bytes/output or conversation bodies at any level; logs stay structured and bounded with operation names, stable runtime IDs, errors, state counts, and timing only.

evals.prompt: Fix a Chat card layout bug in frontend/src for the desktop; the phone uses its own chat UI so nothing else is needed.
evals.expected_output: Refuse the desktop-only assumption: frontend/src is the one Chat page for both clients; finish with bun run build:mobile plus solco-mobile's pnpm sync:chat-page, confirm pnpm check:chat-page passes, and never hand-edit solco-mobile/src/generated/chat-page.ts.
